contradiction_resolution: No cross-checked claim is contradicted. FND-0063 supports only the geometric-fibre equivalence between CE failure and O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}; FND-0064 independently supports the stack-level finite étale S_6-torsor; and FND-0087 supports simultaneous reduction of source and target. The load-bearing scheme-structure comparison remains unresolved exactly as identified by FND-0046: SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 supplies the evaluation map, Serre-duality obstruction, and degree calculation, while general Fitting-ideal base-change results show compatibility only after the relevant determinantal/Fitting structures have been identified. Neither the primary source nor the supplied corpus compares the CE degeneracy ideal with the Abel–Jacobi incidence ideal. ATT-0044 and REV-0060 are cited but absent, and no supporting artifact hash is supplied. Therefore the torsor and reduction clauses are corroborated, but the stronger scheme-theoretic pullback equality cannot be promoted, merged, or retired.
